GT-0107.name: Paying customer
GT-0107.definition: A customer with a paid, non-refunded order in the last 12 months.

GT-0180.name: Golden customer key
GT-0180.definition: The identifier that master data assigns to one real-world customer.

GT-0120.name: Net revenue
GT-0120.definition: Gross sales less returns, discounts and tax.

GT-0131.name: Order date
GT-0131.definition: The date on which the customer placed the order.

GT-0150.name: Open account
GT-0150.definition: An account whose status flag is ACTIVE.

GT-0171.name: Customer contact email
GT-0171.definition: The email address the company uses to contact the customer.
